annotations.title: HTML Table to Structured JSON & Markdown Parser

description: Detects and parses HTML table elements into structured JSON record arrays and GitHub-Flavored Markdown tabular grids. Use when converting financial statements, product comparison grids, or sports statistics into structured data tables; for extracting raw clean markdown prose, use extract_clean_markdown instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('output_format' defaults to 'markdown_and_json'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Raw HTML string containing one or more table, thead, tbody, or tr elements.

min_rows.description: Minimum rows required for a table to be parsed and retained.

output_format.description: Tabular export formatting standard: markdown and JSON, JSON records only, or CSV string.

name: parse_html_tables

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for parse_html_tables.

markdown_tables.description: List of GitHub-Flavored Markdown formatted table strings.

structured_records.description: Parsed array of row objects keyed by header column titles.

tables_found.description: Count of valid HTML tables detected and transformed.

title: HTML Table to Structured JSON & Markdown Parser
